title: Asking for base components builds the real set, with their states, not the five starters
goal: When a person asks for base components, Ask and the Photonz skill know what a real design kit holds (buttons, toggles, text fields, checkboxes, segmented controls, menus, sliders, tabs, list rows, alerts and so on) and build each one as a proper component with its states as variants, instead of reusing the five placeholder starters in the Library.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'when i say components, it only seems to know the placeholder components. it should be able to research what base components might include.' The screenshot queue/audits/2026-10-20-user-ask-component-sheet-mess.png shows Badge, Nav Bar, Card, Text Field, Button: the app's starters.

Suspect, NOT confirmed: Ask's tool list (Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPlanning.swift line 24) does include run_command, so make_component and add_variant are reachable in principle; the model may not know they exist, or what goes in them, because the prompt hands it the Library's starters up front (the Ask task chose that on 2026-10-20). Reproduce before fixing. The skill can (plugin/skills/photonz/SKILL.md line 41) but its text points at the starters (line 88). 'Research' without the web is the built-in list; looking things up on the web is the separate web task, which this one does not wait on. Runs before the component sheet task, which lays these out as a table.
acceptance: Asking 'create a table of apple like quality base components that show different states and text' builds at least twelve kinds of base component that are NOT the Library's starters, each a real component in the Library with its states (for example default, hover, pressed, disabled, and on and off where the kind has them) as variants

What a kit holds comes from a built-in list shipped with the app and the skill (each kind, its usual states and its usual words), so it works offline; Apple's own kit is the reference for names and states
Ask makes new components and variants itself rather than only placing what is in the Library, each request one undo
The components look Apple-quality: one type scale, system colours, consistent corner radius and padding across kinds, measured from the read document and in the audit

Scored with the eval (a-scored-test-set-for-what-ask-and-the-photonz-s): its component cases go up from the baseline, for both Ask and the skill, before and after in the audit. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: manager 2026-10-20: Ask's guidance lives in AskPlanning.swift (system prompt from :426) and the skill's in plugin/skills/photonz/SKILL.md. Put the built-in kit list in one file both read, not a copy in each.
